games.title: Solitaire
games.sub: The classic patience, with big clear cards. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: FreeCell
games.sub: Every card face up, so you can plan. Four levels, today's deal, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Spider
games.sub: Build each suit from King to Ace. One suit to four, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: TriPeaks
games.sub: Clear three peaks with cards one higher or lower. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Pyramid
games.sub: Take away pairs that make 13 until the pyramid has gone. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: 365 Invaders
games.sub: Our own 80s arcade shooter, with power-ups, combos and a Mothership boss. A gentle speed and a Hall of Fame.

games.title: 365 Bat & Ball
games.sub: Knock out the bricks: 20 levels, exploding bricks, lasers, three balls, two Motherships and a Hall of Fame.

games.title: 365 Eclipse
games.sub: A 3D jet shooter: seven stages from harbour to orbit, four fighters, red and blue guns, medals and huge bosses.

games.title: Seafront
games.sub: Ride an eFoil, jet ski or RIB along the real Bournemouth seafront. Best on a newer PC.
